# weir auth

<!-- Generated by `weir reference`. Do not edit: change the help text in src/main.rs and regenerate. -->

Manage the accounts weir signs in to providers with.

```text
Manage the accounts weir signs in to providers with

Usage: weir auth [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  login   Add an account, or replace the token of an existing one
  list    List accounts and check that each token still works
  logout  Remove an account

Options:
      --json
          Machine-readable output

  -q, --quiet
          Print errors only

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## weir auth login

Add an account, or replace the token of an existing one.

```text
Add an account, or replace the token of an existing one

Usage: weir auth login [OPTIONS] <HOST>

Arguments:
  <HOST>
          The provider host, for example github.com

Options:
      --json
          Machine-readable output

      --name <NAME>
          A name for the account; defaults to its login on the provider

      --env <ENV>
          Read the token from this environment variable each time

  -q, --quiet
          Print errors only

      --command <COMMAND>
          Run this command to get the token each time, e.g. "gh auth token"

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## weir auth list

List accounts and check that each token still works.

```text
List accounts and check that each token still works

Usage: weir auth list [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --json
          Machine-readable output

  -q, --quiet
          Print errors only

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## weir auth logout

Remove an account.

```text
Remove an account

Usage: weir auth logout [OPTIONS] <NAME>

Arguments:
  <NAME>


Options:
      --json
          Machine-readable output

  -q, --quiet
          Print errors only

  -h, --help
          Print help
```
